result.effect: Psychiatry 95.51%, neurology 95.49%, surgery 95.38%; neonatology 77.54%, otolaryngology 76.64%, urology/nephrology 76.59%

cells.quote: The results indicate that the highest accuracies were achieved in specialties such as psychiatry (95.51%), neurology (95.49%), and surgery (95.38%). The accuracies of specialties such as neonatology (77.54%), otolaryngology (76.64%), and urology and nephrology (76.59%) were lower.
cells.note: Descriptive specialty-level subgroup results, not a randomized instructional comparison; the study text does not report a direct significance test for these specialty contrasts.
